name: step1
when: Footsteps on dry floor (left foot); also the thud of a hard landing or a jump's push-off.

name: step2
when: Footsteps on dry floor (right foot), alternating with step1.

name: wade1
when: Footsteps sloshing while you walk through a liquid you can stand in.

name: wade2
when: Footsteps sloshing through a liquid, alternating with wade1.

name: swim1
when: A swimming stroke while you're out of your depth in a liquid.

name: swim2
when: A swimming stroke out of your depth, alternating with swim1.

name: jump
when: You jump (one of three grunts, picked at random).

name: jump2
when: You jump (one of three grunts, picked at random).

name: jump3
when: You jump (one of three grunts, picked at random).

name: hurt
when: You take damage (one of three grunts, picked at random).

name: hurt2
when: You take damage (one of three grunts, picked at random).

name: hurt3
when: You take damage (one of three grunts, picked at random).

name: hurt-zap
when: You're shocked - by a laser, a live floor or the network - on top of the grunt.

name: die
when: You die, including hitting the bottom of a death pit.

name: heartbeat
when: A heartbeat while your health is low, quicker as it drops.
trigger_use: Tension: a low-health or danger cue.

name: breath
when: A heavy breath now and then while your health is low.

name: groan
when: A quiet groan now and then while your health is low.

name: gasp1
when: A quiet gasp now and then while your health is low (one of three).

name: gasp2
when: A quiet gasp now and then while your health is low (one of three).

name: gasp3
when: A quiet gasp now and then while your health is low (one of three).

name: kick-swing
when: You kick: the swing, hit or miss.

name: kick
when: Your kick lands on a machine, a prop or a glass pane.

name: wallhump
when: You press USE on a plain wall with nothing there.

name: bump
when: Not played by the game itself (spare: it only stands in for the kick if kick.wav is missing).

name: shoot
when: Firing the blaster; also ticks while the sector-clear tally counts up.

name: scatter
when: Firing the scatter gun.

name: repeater
when: Firing the repeater.

name: rail
when: Firing the railgun.

name: rocket-fire
when: Firing the rocket launcher.

name: rocket-boom
when: A rocket or a turret's missile explodes.

name: empty
when: Pulling the trigger with no ammo: a dry click.

name: charge
when: The blaster or railgun starts charging (CHARGED SHOTS setting).

name: charge-full
when: A charged shot reaches full power (CHARGED SHOTS setting).

name: headshot
when: You land a headshot on a machine.

name: bolt-wall
when: A machine's plasma bolt bursts against a wall, floor or ceiling.

name: health
when: Picking up a health pack or a big medkit.

name: overcharge
when: Picking up an overcharge (+100 health); also a monster spawner bursting as it sends one out.

name: armor
when: Picking up armour, a hazmat suit or a computer repair kit.

name: ammo
when: Picking up energy cells, repeater rounds or railgun slugs.

name: shells
when: Picking up shells or rockets.

name: weapon
when: Picking up a new gun.

name: keycard
when: Picking up a keycard or the sector map.

name: amp
when: Picking up the damage amp (double damage).

name: amp-end
when: The damage amp wears off.

name: invuln
when: Picking up invulnerability.

name: invuln-end
when: Invulnerability wears off.

name: jetfuel
when: Picking up the jetpack or a can of jet fuel.

name: battery
when: Picking up a flashlight battery, or a spare being swapped in.

name: jetpack
when: The jetpack fires: as thrust starts, then repeating while it burns.

name: flashlight
when: The flashlight clicks on or off, or is picked up.
trigger_use: A switch click in the dark.

name: power-up
when: Something powers up: night vision on, power back after a blackout, a computer hacked open.

name: power-down
when: Something dies: a blackout, night vision off, jetpack or flashlight empty, suit worn out, turrets hacked.
trigger_use: Lights out, a machine shutting off.

name: door
when: A sliding door (the usual kind) opens or closes.

name: door-shutter
when: A shutter door opens or closes.

name: door-split
when: A split door (two halves) opens or closes.

name: locked
when: Denied: a locked or sealed door, a locked safe, no signal, or saving not allowed.

name: door-kick
when: You kick a stronghold door.

name: door-break
when: A stronghold door gives way under your kicks.

name: lift-start
when: A lift sets off; also a turret folding out of or back into its housing.

name: lift-move
when: A lift's motor hum, looping while it moves.

name: lift-stop
when: A lift stops; also each reel landing on a slot machine.

name: crusher-slam
when: A crusher slams onto the floor.

name: closet
when: Hidden walls grind away: a trap room's closets opening, a secret found, a wall carved by command.

name: secret
when: You find a secret.

name: teleport
when: A teleporter pad sends you across; also things appearing out of nowhere by command.

name: jumppad
when: A jump pad launches you or a machine.

name: exit
when: You use the sector's exit.

name: plate-click
when: A click: a pressure plate pressed, a shoot switch hit, a secret unlatching, a vending machine dispensing.

name: drain
when: A pool drains (repeating while it drains).

name: splash
when: You enter water or another liquid that doesn't burn; a water barrel bursts.

name: swish
when: Liquid swishing round you as you move through it (a loop, louder the faster and deeper).

name: bubble
when: A looping bubble near a harmful liquid like lava, acid or slime, louder as you near it.

name: sizzle
when: Burning: stepping into lava or acid or on a burning floor, fire traps, flames, a laser warming up.

name: trap-fire
when: A fire trap's roar, looping while it's lit, louder as you near it.

name: trap-electric
when: The buzz of a live electric floor trap or a laser beam, looping while it's on.

name: zap
when: An electric crack: an electric trap hurting you, a laser beam coming on, a lightning turret's arc.

name: laser-zap
when: A laser beam burns you.

name: barrel
when: An explosion: a barrel, a blast trap, a slot machine's bomb; also the sector-clear tally's slams.

name: barrel-leak
when: A shot liquid barrel hisses as it leaks.

name: deco-hit
when: A prop takes a hit without breaking; also shots pinging off bars, a stacked thing landing.

name: crate-break
when: A crate, desk, table, piece of furniture or chest is smashed.

name: lamp-break
when: A lamp is shot out, standing or in the ceiling.

name: plant-break
when: A potted plant is smashed.

name: terminal-break
when: A terminal, computer or other machine prop is smashed.

name: glass-hit
when: A glass pane is hit and cracks, but holds.

name: glass-break
when: A glass pane shatters.
trigger_use: Something breaking in, a window smashed.

name: droid-chirp1
when: A little service droid chatters to itself now and then.

name: droid-chirp2
when: A little service droid chatters to itself now and then.

name: droid-chirp3
when: A service droid is startled: you walked into it or shot it.

name: droid-break
when: A little service droid is destroyed.

name: spawn
when: A machine appears out of nowhere: summoned, out of a broken specimen tank, a slot machine, network ICE.

name: thief-steal
when: A thief bot grabs something of yours.

name: eyebot-beep
when: An eyebot beeps as it rushes at you, faster as it closes in.

name: eyebot-rush
when: An eyebot starts its kamikaze rush at you.

name: robodog-bark1
when: A robot guard dog barks on seeing you (waking machines near) and while it chases you (one of four).

name: robodog-bark2
when: A robot guard dog barks on seeing you (waking machines near) and while it chases you (one of four).

name: robodog-bark3
when: A robot guard dog barks on seeing you (waking machines near) and while it chases you (one of four).

name: robodog-bark4
when: A robot guard dog barks on seeing you (waking machines near) and while it chases you (one of four).

name: turret-flame
when: A flame turret starts a burst of fire.

name: turret-spray
when: A spray turret starts a burst of poison or acid.

name: turret-zap
when: A lightning turret fires.

name: turret-missile
when: A missile turret launches a missile.

name: alarm
when: Siren: an alarm raised (repeating), a room locking down, a hack failing into a lockout.

name: alarm-press
when: An alarm switch is hit - by you or a guard - raising the alarm.

name: alarm-arm
when: A security console switches the alarms on.

name: alarm-disarm
when: An alarm is switched off, at its switch or a security console.

name: keypad-beep
when: Pressing a keypad key, or nudging a launch control's numbers.

name: keypad-ok
when: The right code at a keypad, or a launch control's setting accepted.

name: keypad-bad
when: A wrong code at a keypad.

name: safe-open
when: A safe swings open.

name: search
when: Searching a desk or bookshelf.

name: repair
when: A repair kit fixes a broken computer.

name: camera
when: Switching to a security camera view, or to the next camera.

name: note
when: Reading a note.

name: hoard-open
when: A chest opens, or a thieves' hoard is found or opened.

name: fanfare
when: A win: an event room beaten, a hack or puzzle solved, a jackpot or high score.

name: fail
when: A loss: a wrong puzzle answer, a timed room failed, a hack or arcade game lost.

name: core
when: Taking a data core in the network, solving a terminal puzzle, and pressing any USE trigger.
trigger_use: Already plays when a 'use' trigger is pressed.

name: jack-in
when: You jack into the network.

name: jack-out
when: You jack out of the network.

name: achievement
when: An achievement unlocks and its notice pops up.

name: MONSTER-alert / -attack / -shoot / -hit / -pain / -die / -idle / -hunt
when: Per machine: idle mutter, alert on spotting you, hunt while chasing, attack/shoot, hit when shot, pain on headshots, die.
trigger_use: e.g. sound sentry-alert: an unseen machine noticing you.

name: menu-*
when: Menu clicks: move, select, back, slider step, toggle on/off, choice; menu-move/select also in the arcade game.
